opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A), up to £500 (Scheme B), up to £750 for Adelphi co‑sponsored award, up to £300 (Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scheme A: undergraduate, Master’s and PhD students and postdocs within six years of PhD viva (members). Schemes B & C: PhD students and postdocs within six years of PhD viva (members). UK‑based members for non‑Society meetings; non‑UK members for UK meetings.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientists at conferences (Society meetings, other meetings, or virtual conferences).

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a UK‑based course. Students need a supervisor letter; supervisors must be members.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to attend short genetics‑related training courses or collaborative lab visits.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members who study or work in the UK, or intend to carry out fieldwork in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Funds travel and accommodation for field‑based genetic research projects suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Several hundred pounds up to about £1,000; major sponsorship levels £1,000‑£2,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society may apply at any time; priority to early‑career scientists.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship for genetics‑themed meetings not organised directly by the Society, including provision for Carer’s Awards.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, covering travel and material costs (UK‑based travel only).
